name: @pideck/install
description: One-line install, service setup and guided onboarding for PiDeck (launchd/systemd)

scripts.build: sh -c 'if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck bootstrap.sh onboard.sh uninstall.sh bin/pideck bin/pideck-daemon lib/*.sh test/*.sh; else echo "shellcheck not installed; skipping shell lint"; fi && sh test/run-all.sh'
